==Notes==
*This skill is initially the {{skill icon|Unknown Junundu Ability}}.
**After completing the [[List of skill acquisition quests|skill acquisition quest]], this skill will be available whenever your character is riding a [[Junundu]] in [[the Desolation]]. Even if you skipped the first half of the quest, the skill will become available after accepting the reward.
*This skill cannot be copied with [[Arcane Mimicry]].
*This is the only skill apart from [[Burning Breath]] that can damage the [[Horde of Darkness (NPC)|Horde of Darkness]].
